Add Docker deployment configuration and Phase 2-4 backend apps

This commit adds comprehensive Docker support and implements Phase 2-4 backend applications for the School Management System SaaS platform.

## Docker Configuration

### Development Environment
- docker-compose-dev.yml: Complete development stack
  - PostgreSQL 16 with health checks
  - Redis 7 for caching and Celery
  - Django web server with hot reload
  - Celery worker and beat scheduler
  - Flower for Celery monitoring \(port 5555\)
  - Debug port 5678 for remote debugging

### Production Environment
- docker-compose-prod.yml: Production-ready stack
  - Nginx reverse proxy with SSL/TLS
  - Gunicorn WSGI server \(4 workers, 2 threads\)
  - PostgreSQL with persistent volumes
  - Redis with password authentication
  - Scalable Celery workers
  - Health checks and auto-restart policies
  - Security headers and rate limiting

### Docker Infrastructure
- docker/development/: Dev Dockerfile and entrypoint script
- docker/production/: Production Dockerfile, entrypoint, and nginx config
- docker/README.md: Comprehensive deployment guide
- .env.production.example: Production environment template

## Phase 2: Forums & Community \(forums app\)

### Models
- ForumCategory: Hierarchical forum categorization
- ForumThread: Discussion threads with pinning/locking
- ForumPost: Thread posts with edit history
- ThreadSubscription: Email notifications for thread updates
- ForumModeration: Moderation actions logging

### Features
- Thread creation, editing, deletion with permissions
- Post replies with quote support
- Thread pinning and locking \(moderators\)
- User subscriptions to threads
- View counting and last activity tracking
- Moderation system with action logging
- REST API with pagination and filtering

### Celery Tasks
- send_thread_notification: Notify subscribers of new posts
- send_moderation_notification: Alert users of moderation actions
- cleanup_old_notifications: Scheduled cleanup \(daily\)

## Phase 3: Certificates & Grading

### certificates app

#### Models
- CertificateTemplate: Customizable certificate designs
- Certificate: Issued certificates with QR codes
- CertificateVerification: Verification attempt logging
- BatchCertificateGeneration: Bulk certificate generation

#### Features
- PDF certificate generation with WeasyPrint
- QR code generation for verification
- Hash-based certificate authentication
- Blockchain hash support \(optional\)
- Certificate revocation system
- Batch generation for course completion
- Public verification endpoint
- REST API for certificate management

#### Celery Tasks
- generate_certificate_batch: Async bulk generation
- send_certificate_email: Email certificates to students

### grading app

#### Models
- GradingRubric: Rubrics with multiple criteria
- RubricCriterion: Weighted grading criteria
- RubricGrade: Applied grades for students
- CriterionGrade: Individual criterion scores
- PeerReview: Peer evaluation system
- GradeCurve: Statistical grade adjustments

#### Features
- Multi-criteria rubric system
- Weighted scoring and percentage calculations
- Peer review workflow \(pending/completed\)
- Anonymous peer reviews option
- Grade curving \(linear, bell, custom\)
- Grade appeal workflow
- Detailed feedback per criterion
- REST API with filtering and statistics

#### Celery Tasks
- calculate_grade_statistics: Generate grade analytics
- send_peer_review_reminders: Deadline reminders
- process_grade_curve: Apply statistical adjustments

- Student performance tracking \(GPA, attendance, engagement\)
- Course completion rates and average grades
- Teacher workload and performance metrics
- Attendance trend analysis
- Payment collection tracking
- Custom report builder
- Data export \(CSV, JSON, Excel\)
- Scheduled report generation
- REST API with advanced filtering

- update_attendance_analytics: Attendance pattern analysis
